# TopologyAwareFloorplanning

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A chip floorplanning approach that explicitly incorporates the target interconnect topology into the placement optimization process. Aligns physical layout with logical interconnect requirements, reducing latency and energy in TCC architectures.
